text:
omar: I opened PR to add a short migration guide + banner for v1->v2. Two quick items: param rename `model` -> `model_id` and embeddings dim change (512 -> 768). Need short rollback-safe examples and a clear checklist.

tara: Can you drop the before/after snippets here so I can sanity-check our quickstart pages?

omar: Old example (v1):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"Hello"}'
```

New example (v2):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-small-v2","input":"Hello"}'
```

jules: For docs samples, include a compatibility shim (very short) and a test assertion so grammars catch it in CI.

mike_ops: For Dedicated/Private customers we should include an ops note: reindexing may be required and we can schedule a maintenance window. Add a contact link.

sdk-team: We'll add tiny shims in the SDKs that accept both keys for one release. Suggest the docs say "temporary shim". Example (python shim):
```python
def norm(p):
  if 'model_id' in p: return p
  if 'model' in p: p['model_id']=p.pop('model')
  return p
```

omar: Great. I also added a short embed probe for customers to detect mismatched vector size:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"model_id":"embed-base-v2","input":"probe"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

tara: Nice. Add a one-paragraph FAQ "why did my similarity drop" linking to reindex steps.

jules: I'll review wording in the banner—use "deprecated" with explicit timeline and call out that hosted has dual-support for 60 days.

omar: Action items in PR: [1] docs wording review (jules, tara) [2] tiny SDK shims (sdk-team) [3] ops contact blurb for managed customers (mike_ops) [4] probe CI job for docs samples (tara). Docs-bot: posted PR link in thread.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4988 (labels: docs, breaking-change, migration)

omar: Please skim PR #4988 today; if no blockers I'll merge and publish the deprecation banner by EOD. :rocket:
